answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-bonded identity gate. Each submission must solve the live epoch challenge, but it counts only for an address that already locked capital on chain. Extra keys do not multiply influence: the ledger scores an identity by its locked balance, and emission stays fixed per epoch. A swarm gains power only after funding real capital, so capture cost rises with the square of the army size. Fresh nodes yield an echo of an empty pool, find no reef of prior work to lean on, and cannot fake the marble of settlement randomness.
